external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Bridget spearheaded the implementation of the After 22 program in collaboration with Chicago City Colleges. This pioneering transition program for students with developmental disabilities was initially piloted in March 2022 with ten students and has since expanded to include over fifty-four participants, opening doors for students to learn and practice work-life readiness skills with a growing number of Chicago employers.
